blurb: Duet Dance Academy offers a variety of dance classes including ballet, hip hop, jazz, tap, contemporary, acro, and a special needs program called A Chance To Dance. Classes focus on technique, creativity, and confidence building. They also host birthday parties with themed dance activities and a Nutcracker Storybook Dance Camp.
